summary: nDCG@10 0.681 pointwise and 0.668 listwise, against 0.743 for the trained reranker and 0.671 for BM25 alone, at about 20.3 and 13.9 seconds per claim against 4.83; pairwise comparisons on 50 claims did best of the three (0.764 against 0.747 for BM25 and 0.782 for Qwen3-Reranker on the same claims, top 10)
note: Same 100 claims (every third test claim), same BM25 candidates. Pointwise: 100 of the 2000 calls lacked a yes or no log-probability among the top 20 and were scored at the floor. Listwise: 0 identifiers missing over 300 calls (0 calls had to be repaired); 5 of 300 calls returned the input order unchanged. Pairwise: the two orders disagreed on 338 of 850 comparisons (position bias), kept as ties. Seconds are wall time on this laptop with llama-server's prompt cache on (the shared system prompt and claim are reused between calls); the trained rerankers' seconds are one batch of 20 on MPS.
